Document 1 (D1S3) explicitly states that in the 1988 version, 'The player controls Roger Rabbit', identifying him as the main character for that release. Document 2 (D2S5) explicitly states that in the 1989 NES version, 'The player controls private detective Eddie Valiant', identifying him as the main character for that release. Since the question does not specify a platform or year, both characters are valid answers corresponding to their respective game versions. The fallible audits correctly identified these as direct supports from D1S3 and D2S5 respectively.
